summary: Flushes the buffered write stream of the file/write object at a1 via BufferFlushWrite; on flush failure returns -1. Otherwise tests the error flag byte at a1+0xD for bit 0x40; when set, validates the OS file handle read from a1+0x10 via sub_592891 and returns -1 when the handle is invalid, else 0; when the bit is clear returns 0.

local_names.a1: file/write object with error-flag byte at +0xD and OS handle at +0x10

operations.description: Flush the buffered write stream for the object a1: BufferFlushWrite(a1).
If the flush returned non-zero (failure), return -1 immediately.
Check the error flag byte at a1 + 0xD: if bit 0x40 is set, enter the write-error handle-validation path.
Validate the OS file handle read from a1 + 0x10: sub_592891(*(_DWORD *)(a1 + 16)).
Return -(sub_592891(...) != 0): -1 when the handle is invalid, 0 when it is still valid.
Return 0 when bit 0x40 of the flag byte is not set (no write error).
